Enforcement Directorate Questions Pinarayi Vijayan's Daughter in Probe

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has questioned Veena Vijayan, daughter of Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, in connection with a probe. Sources indicate that Veena arrived at the ED office for questioning. The ED is reportedly widening its investigation into the CMRL-Exalogic case and is expected to extend its probe to the Pinarayi government, focusing on how Veena secured a contract with CMRL.
